description: This file defines the PipesClient class within the Aws\Pipes namespace, which is used to interact with the Amazon EventBridge Pipes service through various methods such as createPipe, deletePipe, describePipe, and more. It leverages the inheritance from AwsClient and includes method annotations for both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: PipesClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon EventBridge Pipes service.

methods.name: createPipe
methods.description: Creates a new pipe with specified configuration.

methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific pipe.
